about.en:
Milaha's Qatarisation page describes an internship programme for national students in universities, colleges and high secondary schools. Placements last 4 to 8 weeks, and supervisors award a Certificate of Achievement at the end.

Milaha's 2016 announcement said the programme ran in January, April, June and July and targeted maritime, engineering, finance and business majors. Applications are made through an online form asking for name, gender, QID, email and phone.

en: Maritime and logistics placement at a major Qatari group
Certificate of Achievement at the end
Open to university, college and high-school students

eligibility.en: Qatari nationals only: the page says 'national students' in universities, colleges and high secondary schools, and the form requires a QID number. Non-Qataris are not eligible. No GPA or major is listed on the current page (the 2016 announcement mentioned maritime, engineering, finance and business).

en: Open the Milaha Qatarisation page and click the internship application form
Fill in full name, gender, QID number, email and phone
Contact info@milaha.com or +974 4494 9666 for current intake windows

Shell Qatar's 'Qatar Shell Internship Experience' is listed on Shell's Qatar student pages. The 2026 cycle was a paid 6-8 week summer programme at Ras Laffan and Doha for Qatari engineering students early in their studies, with applications opening in March 2026.

A 2027 cycle has not been announced; follow the same March pattern and check the page. Details here come from the official page title and the 2026 listing, so confirm on the page before applying.
